summary: Comprehensive testing of Turkish coupon & deals website completed successfully. All major features working perfectly including coupon modals, search functionality, hamburger menu, theme toggle, and mobile responsiveness. Backend APIs 100% functional with 10 brands and proper demo data.
passed_tests: All 12 backend API endpoints (100% success rate)
Coupon modal functionality with UTM redirect
Discount cards showing info without modal
Hamburger menu with Mağazalar, İletişim, Kupon Gönder links
Search functionality finding brands, coupons, discounts
Light/Dark theme toggle with localStorage persistence
Hero slider with correct heights (40vh mobile, 50vh desktop)
10 brands visible on homepage and stores page
Brand pages with correct tab counts (Tümü 4, Kuponlar 2, İndirimler 2)
Contact page at /iletisim with form elements
Demo data: Nike, Adidas, Puma, Converse, Lacoste brands
Each brand has 2 coupons and 2 discounts as required
